escena: SCENE (documentary, a real photograph inside Efeonce's creative studio in Santiago at night, in the middle of a campaign push): a large, modern, frameless pen display lies almost flat on a matte black desk, and on it ONE campaign for a fictitious sneaker brand fills the screen as a tight grid of about forty finished pieces: vertical stories, square posts, wide banners and email headers, every one in the SAME visual system (deep navy, white and cool blue, the same photograph of one fictitious white sneaker, the same diagonal composition), no readable letters, no numbers, no logos. Two hands of a designer in her early thirties work on it mid-action, anatomically natural, five fingers each, relaxed and graceful, smooth healthy skin with fine natural texture, short clean unpainted nails, one thin silver ring: the right hand, holding a slim black stylus like a pen in a light, natural grip, drags the LAST missing piece into the one empty slot of the grid, at the instant it snaps into place, wrapped in a thin royal-blue (#0375DB) selection outline, the blue carrier of the frame; the left hand rests lightly on the edge of the display, fingers together and relaxed. ONE single tiny point on the dragged piece glows vivid orange (#FF6500), the only warm accent in the frame. The camera is low and close, about forty centimetres from the hands, 50mm f/2, looking across the screen at a shallow angle so the grid recedes and the farthest pieces fall softly out of focus. The glowing azure screen is the only light: it lights the hands from below with cool white-blue; the rest of the studio behind is dark, with two or three cold out-of-focus monitor glows far away. Current-generation hardware only: frameless displays, a thin aluminium stylus, a matte black desk with nothing else on it; no notebooks, no paper, no mugs, no plants, no lamps. Real skin with fine natural texture, never wrinkled or aged, no veins standing out. Real sensor grain, genuine depth of field. No readable text, no logos of any brand.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the matte black desk right in front of the lens, out of focus, outside the screen's light
